children: Group 1 Automotive entered a master credit agreement to obtain a secured term loan of up to $190.3 million, equal to 85% of the appraised value of pledged properties. The facility, provided by Bank of America, bears interest at Term SOFR plus 145 basis points and does not permit reborrowing of repaid principal. The loan is secured by mortgages on designated properties and related assets and is guaranteed by the company and certain subsidiaries. The agreement matures on Sep 23, 2033.
: Long-term real estate financing and liquidity for operations and growth
